description: This is an abstract class definition for unary expression nodes in Twig's template engine. It provides common functionality for unary operators, including constructor validation and compilation logic.

classes.name: AbstractUnary
classes.description: An abstract class for unary expression nodes, providing common compilation logic and validation for unary operations in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the unary node with a child node and line number, with deprecation warning if the node is not an instance of AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the unary expression node, including parentheses and operator, into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to output the specific unary operator during compilation.
